name: Publishing
purpose: Verify packaging, secrets, rights, attribution, digests, installation and restoration before external release.

baseline_claims.need: The package inventory, version and digests match the released artifact.
Private paths, credentials, caches and raw logs are absent.
Source, licence and attribution records cover distributable assets.
A clean beginner machine can install, launch and reach the intended hub.
Upgrade, delta and rollback paths preserve user-owned state.
The downloaded bytes match the reviewed bytes.
